title: Deer trophy
content:
# Deer trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyDeer | Source: Deer | Usage: Decoration, summon, Eikthyr | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Deer Trophy is a rare drop from Deers in the Meadows.

### Boss Summoning

A total of two Deer Trophies are required at the Mystical Altar to summon the first boss Eikthyr.

### Crafting

• Mead horn of Odin
• Stagbreaker

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

Categorias: Trophies, Materials, Forsaken offerings
